_about: Club culture effects. Director 2026-10-13: small, then measure; both ways for Standards and Togetherness. 2026-10-18: build them; Ambition helps re-signing and free agents on the winning-now side, and brings young players on a touch quicker on the patient side (veterans' asks are not lower there). Lead 2026-10-18: young_ceiling is points of season training ceiling for the young at a patient club (the Develop plan's lever; 0 turns it off), because the season ceiling otherwise caps the extra XP. Keys are the band names in Culture.BANDS; a band not listed does nothing. Every club follows the same rule. Sizes are the director's to set in his playtest.
